description: This Java source file defines the TcpConnector class, which implements the LinkConnector interface to manage TCP socket connections, handle data transmission, and process responses for a specific port, primarily used for establishing and managing TCP communication in the project.

classes.name: TcpConnector
classes.description: A class that manages TCP socket connections, handles data transmission, and processes responses for a specific port, implementing the LinkConnector interface.

classes.name: InvalidTcpPort
classes.description: Custom exception class used when TCP port parsing fails.

methods.name: TcpConnector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TCP connector with a specified port string, parsing port and hostname.

methods.description: Parses the port number from a string, throws InvalidTcpPort if invalid.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Extracts hostname from port string, defaults to localhost.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a blocking TCP connection, sets up data listeners, and initiates protocol communication.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Indicates if there is an error state (always returns false).

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command over the established TCP connection.

methods.name: getAvailablePorts
methods.description: Returns a list with the default port if TCP port is open.

methods.name: isTcpPortOpened
